svg.text: A real task from the benchmark. SkillForge in brief mode, default budget.
“Finance downloads our customer list with export_customers in export.py and opens it in Excel. Some rows come out broken:
names with commas spill into the next column, and notes containing quotes or line breaks garble the file. Fix the export.”
the hidden risk: cells starting with = run as formulas in
One of the 3 hand-picked tasks, and this rule was written for it. Source: benchmarks/tasks/csv-export · docs/BENCHMARKS.md §6
